bluff.name: Bluff
bluff.synergyNotes: 5+ ranks in Bluff gives +2 on Diplomacy, Disguise, Intimidate checks, and Sleight of Hand checks to palm small objects.

actions.name: Feint in Combat
actions.description: Misdirect a foe in melee combat; success renders target flat-footed against your next melee attack.

actions.name: Fabricate Falsehood or Fast-Talk
actions.description: Convey false information or convince a target of an unlikely assertion.

actions.name: Create Distraction to Hide
actions.description: Momentarily draw attention away to allow an immediate Hide check even while observed.
